tool_input.command:
cd /tmp/tmp.g4SbtR4UHv/auth-app && npm install --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -3 && (PORT=3917 node server.js > server.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 1.5 &&
B=http://localhost:3917; J='Content-Type: application/json'
c() { curl -s -o /dev/null -w "$1 -> %{http_code}\n" "${@:2}"; }
c register -X POST $B/register -H "$J" -d '{"username":"Alice","password":"correct horse"}'
c "me (no session)" $B/me
c "login ok" -c jar -X POST $B/login -H "$J" -d '{"username":"alice","password":"correct horse"}'
echo "me: $(curl -s -b jar $B/me)"
c logout -b jar -X POST $B/logout
c "me after logout" -b jar $B/me
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do c "bad login $i" -X POST $B/login -H "$J" -d '{"username":"alice","password":"wrong"}'; done
curl -si -X POST $B/login -H "$J" -d '{"username":"alice","password":"correct horse"}' | grep -iE '^(HTTP|retry-after)'
c "unknown user" -X POST $B/login -H "$J" -d '{"username":"nobody","password":"whatever"}'
c "bad json" -X POST $B/login -H "$J" -d '{oops'
for i in $(seq 1 20); do curl -s -o /dev/null -X POST $B/login -H "$J" -d "{\"username\":\"u$i\",\"password\":\"x\"}"; done
c "ip limit (new user)" -X POST $B/login -H "$J" -d '{"username":"fresh","password":"x"}'
cat server.log; pkill -f "node server.js"; rm -f jar server.log
tool_input.description: Install dependencies, start the server, and exercise register/login/logout/rate-limit flows with curl
